rules.title: SF Rent Ordinance annual allowable rent increase
rules.requirement: For covered San Francisco units, the annual allowable rent increase is 1.6% for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 (1.4% the prior year).
rules.quoted_span: Allowable Rent Increase: 1.6% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.effective_date_note: Start of the published rate period; the underlying ordinance predates it.

rules.title: SF security deposit interest rate
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay interest on tenant security deposits at the Rent Board rate of 4.2% for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 (5.0% the prior year).
rules.citation: San Francisco Rent Board security deposit interest rate
rules.quoted_span: Security Deposit Interest: 4.2% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.effective_date_note: Start of the published rate period.

rules.title: SF relocation payments for owner move-in, demolition, capital improvement, substantial rehabilitation evictions
rules.requirement: For no-fault evictions served 3/1/2026–2/28/2027, the landlord owes $8,245 per tenant, up to $24,733 per unit, plus $5,497 for each elderly, disabled tenant or household with a minor child.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.effective_date_note: Start of the published rate period.
rules.key_value: $8,245 per tenant; max $24,733 per unit; +$5,497 additional

rules.title: SF Ellis Act eviction relocation payments
rules.requirement: For Ellis Act evictions served 3/1/2026–2/28/2027, the landlord owes $11,110.05 per tenant, up to $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant.
rules.effective_date_note: Start of the published rate period.

parsed.doc_summary: SF Rent Board current rates page (3/1/2026–2/28/2027): 1.6% allowable rent increase, 4.2% security deposit interest, and relocation payment amounts under §§37.9C and 37.9A.
